CHARACTER "WORKER": a young American full-time worker. Faded dusty-blue button-up work shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, worn untucked; khaki chino trousers; plain brown belt; grey sneakers; a navy canvas messenger bag on the character's own right hip, strap across the chest; a lanyard with a blank white ID card. No logos and no writing on any clothing.

LAYOUT, three rows, every figure complete, same scale, evenly spaced, never overlapping:
Row 1, turnaround, six full-body views of WORKER: front view, left side view, right side view, back view, three-quarter front view, three-quarter back view. In side views the face is a single dot eye near the facing edge; the back view head is a blank white circle.
Row 2, six full-body action poses of WORKER: waving hello; holding up a sheet of paper with both hands; pointing to the right with one arm straight; shrugging with both palms up; thinking with one hand on the chin; running.
Row 3, twelve head-only expression circles of WORKER: neutral, smiling, happy, angry, sad, worried, scared, surprised, confused, determined, tired, laughing.
Text: a title in the top-left corner reading "THE MEDIAN WORKER" in bold condensed capitals with the smaller line "character sheet" under it, and a short label in plain dark grey sans-serif centred under each figure (for example "Front View", "Waving", "Neutral"). No other text.
</SYSTEM_MESSAGE>
